description: Curated business-day calendars for days not yet observed. Per year: weekdays that are NOT business days (non_working) and weekend days that ARE business days (working_weekends); every other day follows Monday-Friday. Past days are superseded by observed trading (ref.calendar_day source observed_*), current-year MOEX days by the MOEX ISS calendar (source moex_iss_calendar).
